tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Friendly narrative blocks anchored by product conversation evidence. Human language and color make workplace software feel social without hiding its utility.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. A recognizable multi-color identity stays bounded while text and surfaces remain quieter.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Product examples show exchange, coordination, and shared context instead of generic dashboards.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Calls to action and explanations reduce formality without becoming vague.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Warm collaboration story with a real conversation proof strip and bounded brand color. Product, photography, illustration, and data each receive a separate job.
